I visit the hovd of the cottager, and the palace of the king. I come to the good, and I come to the bad. I make the pauper, and I make the magnate. I have visited all places, from the catacombs of Egypt, to the western limits of the United States. I have been, and I will be, everywhere. I have been, and I will be, always. judge.description: The speaker presents as a friend to all people who travels everywhere and treats rich and poor alike.

rows.text: I am a British ship, in good condition, of three hundred tons burden, and am navigated by twenty mariners. I am engaged in the transport service, and can carry soldiers to the sea-shore, for the purpose of being conveyed to Great Britain, in order to serve on board her fleets. I am capable of Kaning fifty thousand pounds worth of treasure, and am worth running after in the night. I am faithful to the state, in whose service I am employed, and to every private person, whom I am engaged to convey, for I faithfully convey them; and I am serviceable to the physician, and to the sportsman, on whose account I am taken at sea. rows.text: I am a space of infinite space, infinite in all directions. I am boundless space. I am nowhere space, and everywhere space. I am space spaceless. I am space space. I am space.
